item.title: Mineralys Hypertension Drug
item.description:
• Summary: Mineralys Therapeutics is making strategic financial moves ahead of a potential approval for its hypertension drug lorundrostat. The company is positioning itself for commercial launch as the aldosterone synthase inhibitor nears a regulatory decision.
  • MoAs: Lorundrostat: Aldosterone synthase inhibitor, reducing aldosterone production to lower blood pressure in resistant hypertension.
  • Sources: Endpoints News
